claim: Antisense oligonucleotide therapy may be able to treat some symptoms of Angelman syndrome in mice.
source: Experiments on mice suggest that an approach called antisense oligonucleotide therapy may be able to treat some symptoms of Angelman syndrome, including problems with epilepsy and sleep.
evidence: The abstract states that experiments on mice suggest this therapeutic possibility.
